text:
Ava (Support): FYI getting several customer escalations — large spike in 401s for API requests across hosted and dedicated. Customers report: "invalid_api_key". Started ~07:02 UTC. raising here so oncall can triage.

auth-monitor-bot: ALERT: auth-service:token-validation-errors rate 4.2x baseline (07:03 UTC) — 5xx/4xx surge. http://internal.metrics/redwood/auth-service/alerts

Noah (Oncall): taking. any correlated deploys or config changes in the last 30m?

Ava (Support): Support sees a deploy notification for `auth-key-rotation` at 06:58 from deploy-bot. Several customers mention they rotated their API keys earlier today but that shouldn't matter.

deploy-bot: Deployed `auth-key-rotation:v2025-07` to prod at 06:58 UTC by diego. CI run green.

Noah (Oncall): Priya, can you check token validation service and JWKs? Sounds like key rotation regression.

Priya (eng-runtime): Looking. `kubectl -n auth get pods` shows auth-validator-0/1 healthy. Logs show lots of validation errors: `ERROR token_validator: Unknown kid 'kid_9f2b'` around 06:59. Pulling JWK set from KeyService returns only new keys; old keys missing.

Priya (eng-runtime): Repro locally: fetch JWKs -> validate token signed with rotated key -> fails. Old JWKs were supposed to be served for 24h after rotation. KeyService returned only new JWKs. Suspect rollover job removed previous keys prematurely.

Diego (eng-infra): That matches the rotation job output. I see a flag `--prune-old-keys=true` enabled in v2025-07 — intended to prune after 1h but a bug made it immediate. Rolling config back now.

Noah (Oncall): Action plan: 1) Rollback key-rotation deploy to v2025-06 (fast). 2) Add temporary acceptance for tokens signed by archived keys in auth-validator. 3) Notify affected customers and escalate to SRE/infra. Priya + Diego take 1/2.

Priya (eng-runtime): Rolling back to `auth-key-rotation:v2025-06` — triggering rollout: `kubectl -n infra set image deployment/key-rotation key-rot=registry/redwood/auth-key-rotation:v2025-06`
Priya (eng-runtime): Patch queued to auth-validator to treat missing kid as a soft-fail if archived key present: PR #3487 (link: http://git.internal/redwood/auth/PR/3487). Will hotfix if rollback doesn't restore keys quickly.

Diego (eng-infra): Rollback started at 07:12 UTC. Kubernetes rollout status: `deployment "key-rotation" successfully rolled back` (07:15 UTC).

auth-monitor-bot: RECOVERED: auth-service:token-validation-errors back to baseline at 07:18 UTC.

Ava (Support): Early signals — several customers report keys worked again around 07:19. Marking tickets as in-progress and sending interim message.

Noah (Oncall): Confirming metrics: 401 rate fell from spike back to normal by 07:18. No 5xx spike. Last known error window ~06:59-07:18 (19m).

Priya (eng-runtime): Verified JWK endpoint now contains both old and new keys as expected. Sample JWKs: ```[{"kid":"kid_6a1b","alg":"RS256"},{"kid":"kid_9f2b","alg":"RS256"}]```

Priya (eng-runtime): Postmortem notes: root cause = key-rotation prune flag regression in v2025-07 enabling immediate prune of old keys. Fix: revert prune behavior, add integration test to ensure old keys remain for configured TTL, and add a canary check that validates tokens signed by archived keys after rollout.

Diego (eng-infra): Also adding a deploy gate: rotation jobs must keep previous JWKs for 24h unless explicit emergency prune is provided. Pushing infra config change and will roll out to staging first.

Ava (Support): Customer comms: draft message posted to support doc (link: http://internal.docs/support/auth-incident-1751234567). Should we offer credits for affected calls? Ops/Finance to advise.

Noah (Oncall): Escalation containment done. Next steps: 1) Postmortem runbook and RCA (owners Priya/Diego). 2) Outreach to customers with impacted request ids (Support to compile list). 3) Add monitoring alert for unexpected JWK set changes. Assigning follow-ups: Priya (RCA & test), Diego (deploy gate + config), Ava (customer outreach).

Priya (eng-runtime): Will open full incident writeup and link it here when ready. Expect draft in 24h.

Diego (eng-infra): Config PR submitted for deploy gate: http://git.internal/redwood/infra/PR/762. Staging rollout scheduled.

Ava (Support): Closing slack thread for active triage. Will re-open if any regression. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Noah (Oncall): Final note: token validity/rotation is high-risk operation. Recommend product/infra review before future rotation windows. Incident closed at 07:21 UTC.

auth-monitor-bot: Incident timeline: created 07:03 UTC, mitigation (rollback) 07:12 UTC, recovery 07:18 UTC, closed 07:21 UTC.
